safety.title: Safety
safety.subtitle: Help is one hold away on every trip.
safety.onRideBody: Open the ride and press and hold SOS for 2 seconds to alert our safety team.
safety.how1: During a ride, press and hold the red SOS button for 2 seconds.
safety.how2: Our safety team gets your live position and trip details at once.
safety.how3: In danger, also call 999 — the national emergency number.
safety.contactsBody: Up to 3 people you can share your trip with quickly. Kept on this phone.
safety.tipPinBody: When asked, tell the driver your 4-digit code so only your driver can start the trip.
safety.tipMaskBody: Drivers never see your full phone number.
safety.tipReportBody: Tell us about anything that made you feel unsafe.
safety.contactExists: This number is already a trusted contact.

support.title: Help & support
support.subtitle: We usually reply within a day.

fare.q: Why was my fare different from the estimate?
fare.a: The final fare uses the real distance and time of your trip, plus any waiting. Your receipt shows each part.

cancel.q: When is there a cancellation fee?
cancel.a: Cancelling while we search, or shortly after a driver accepts, is free. After that, or once the driver has arrived, a fee may apply — the app always shows it before you confirm.

lost.q: I left something in the vehicle
lost.a: Open the ride from Your rides, tap "Get help with this trip" and describe the item. We'll contact the driver.

cash.a: Pay the fare shown on the trip-complete screen to your driver in cash. Digital payments are coming soon.

account.q: How do I change my name or delete my account?
account.a: Go to Profile to change your name. Settings has Delete account.

support.subject: Subject
support.subjectHelp: A short summary, at least 3 characters.
support.closed: This request is closed. Start a new one if you still need help.

notify.offersBody: Promotions and discounts. Off by default.

deleteAccount.step3: Payment and safety records are kept, as the law requires.
deleteAccount.dues: You owe a cancellation fee. Take one more ride (it's added to the fare) or contact support, then try again.
deleteAccount.activeRide: You have a ride in progress. Finish or cancel it first.

permissions.battery: Tip: set battery use for Rider Driver to "Unrestricted" so the phone does not stop it while you drive.
